subject: Yeah, I like it...
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
I like it so far, but I gotta see how it goes first....

No... The controller looks good.. But it needs to be broken in... especially with D-pad controllers. Im not sure if you know what I mean, but a controller that isnt broken is difficult to do some moves because the spring/ or whatever holds that under the d-pad is still rigid..... well at least for me.... So yeah, gotta break that controller first before its actually good to use....
